item.title: Another late comment
item.content:encoded:
Fun fact: I'm the one who wrote the two Roget proposals during the draft phase :)

On a more serious note, happy to finally see this up.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: It’s not tied just to 001 proposals, that’s the initial set that’s here. But it could work for any article on the site or any small idea an author wanted to include. I believe McD intends this to be an ongoing collab project

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I mean its not so much as having the same words as being similar in scope/gravitas. All the other articles have been massively toned down from their originating proposal. Qntm's goes from a mystical lock to an egg timer, swann's is now just a database, etc.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Yeah, I figured my entry was a little too similar to the original. Hopefully it looks different now.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
SCP-ADMN is a collection of anomalous items originating from a prior iteration of existence. Amongst these items is a diary belonging to an individual who would later be known as “The Administrator”. The diary documents much of The Administrator’s final moments in his world as his reality comes to an end via an infestation only described as “The Corruption”.

Is this not just a basic description of the actual proposal? Seems too close to reality, given the toned down nature of the other entries.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
it's hard to put my finger on exactly what I find fun about the exercise, aside from making references and being clever about the kind of typical anomaly that could have been amplified into modern-day ones.

And it seems I'm not alone; the mini-proposals I posted are from me, ralliston, estrellayoshte, IHP, and maybe a couple others that I'm forgetting.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I quite like the appeal of retirement proposals. Although I think, it being tied only to reimaginations of original 001 proposals rather limits the potential of this page, regardless of this being a supplement to your proposal.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Forgive me if I'm being a narrow-minded spoilsport, but I don't quite see the appeal in reimagining existing 001s as sparknotes copies with the drama sucked out of them.

item.title: placeholder
item.content:encoded:
This page is collaborative. Please feel free to add your own re-imagining of an existing 001 proposal. Multiple mini-proposals can be submitted for the same existing proposal, provided they are sufficiently different interpretations of the concept.

EDIT: Extending the available re-imaginings to other big/significant anomalies on the site. Also, if you come up with your own original idea for a retirement proposal that fits the same vibe as the rest of these, then you're free to add that too!
